fact: The Vice-President is reported instructing state company GETESA to present a restructuring plan so its own staff progressively take over maintenance work, cutting costs of external contracting; the network's maintenance is thus currently contracted out.
The article says the GEX case-file platform was developed by CNIAPGE's own technical team, and CNIAPGE's Deploy department staff run its training for the Prime Minister's office.
CNIAPGE, the national centre for computerising public administration, is rolling GEX out to the Primatura at the Prime Minister's request, with ministerial departments to follow.
